# Roadmap

## Phase 1 — reliable core

- [x] Establish private/public data separation.
- [x] Add typed domain models and deterministic scoring.
- [x] Add unit tests and CI workflow.
- [x] Add a Quarto site scaffold and deployment workflow.
- [ ] Run CI and fix any environment-specific failures.

## Phase 2 — measured extraction

- [ ] Create a synthetic, labelled dataset.
- [ ] Add deterministic baseline extraction.
- [ ] Compare optional LLM extraction against the baseline.
- [ ] Publish field-level error analysis and limitations.

## Phase 3 — usable workflow

- [ ] Add CLI commands for validating and scoring JSON records.
- [ ] Add report generation with evidence links.
- [ ] Add data-quality checks for stale postings and duplicate roles.

## Not planned until justified

- Autonomous applications or recruiter outreach.
- Hiring probability estimates.
- A vector database without retrieval benchmarks.
- Complex agent orchestration before deterministic workflows have demonstrated value.
